Titles.jpn: 『劇場版 呪術廻戦「渋谷事変 特別編集版」×「死滅回游 先行上映」

Summaries.eng:
A veil abruptly descends over the busy Shibuya area trapping countless civilians inside. Satoru Gojo, the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, Yuji Itadori, his classmates, and other top-tier jujutsu sorcerers, enter the fray in an unprecedented clash of curses — the Shibuya Incident.

In the aftermath, the deadly Culling Game starts, and Special Grade sorcerer Yuta Okkotsu is assigned to carry out Yuji’s execution for his perceived crimes.

Aliases: Jujutsu Kaisen Movie: Shibuya Jihen Tokubetsu Henshuu-ban x Shimetsu Kaiyuu Senkou Jouei
